dedupe_keys.name: position des bus en circulation sur le reseau star en temps reel

description: Position des bus en circulation sur le réseau STAR en temps réel is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des positions des bus utilisés sur réseau STAR en temps réel, comprenant notamment la ligne et la destination éventuelle sur laquelle ils circulent. Seuls les bus géolocalisés avec succès par le système de gestion de l'exploitation des bus du réseau STAR sont présents dans cette liste. Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are bus, position, géolocalisation, temps réel, star. The portal shows 434 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2014-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
